text:
Anya: Quick sync on argus-13b quant results for longform summary cohort (~1.2k tokens). int8 saves ~34% cost but quality drops in the tail. Recs?

Kai: Give numbers and sample sizes. Could be KV-cache interaction.

Anya: Sample 2k. Auto: ROUGE-L 42.0 -> 38.7 (-3.3). Hallucination 4.7% -> 7.6% (+2.9pp). Human pairwise n=300: int6 preferred 60% vs 40% (p~0.03).

Samir: Unit econ: int6 ~$0.12/1k tokens, int8 ~$0.079/1k -> ~34% savings (~$41 per 1M tokens). For 2M tokens/day that's ~82k/mo. Big win but quality risk for long outputs.

Rachel: Perf delta? p50/p95?

Kai: p50 ~10% faster on int8, p95 ~ same. So cost is main lever.

eval-bot: Metrics table: ROUGE-L|int6:42.0|int8:38.7|delta:-3.3; Hallucination|4.7%|7.6%|+2.9pp; Cost/1k|$0.12|$0.079|-34%

Samir: Proposed policy: default int8 but route expected_output>800 to int6. Start with 5% GTN canary -> 20% holdback. Fallback immediate to int6 if hallucination +1pp over baseline.

Anya: Routing JSON planned: {"routing":[{"cond":"output_tokens>800","model":"argus-13b-int6"},{"cond":"default","model":"argus-13b-int8"}],"holdback":20,"fallback":"argus-13b-int6"}

Rachel: I'll coordinate product panel next Wed for subjective checks.

Kai: Also add ROUGE drift alert at 1.5-point delta on canary slices.

Anya: Filing scorecard (slices: long-article, multipart, instruction-heavy). Flag: argus-13b-routing-v1. Staging rollout tomorrow. :thumbsup:
